note: Ethereum mainnet (chain id 1) infrastructure: pool managers, factories, quoters, routers, position managers, LP lockers, quote currencies and registered blue chips (refused by the meme filter). Never a holder, never a deployer. Every entry was checked 2026-11-20 on https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com: eth_getCode non-empty (size given) plus the role-proving view call named in identifiedBy; entries whose role no view call proves say so. No launchpad is registered for Ethereum (no launchpad-factory / hook / bonding-curve entries; docs/chains/ethereum.md). `cexWallets` are exchange wallets used only to label holder rows (Holder Strength already excludes CEX-labelled wallets); they are not infrastructure and stay counted in top-holder concentration.
